output_list.reason: 1) Current token minting function for users always give back to the address trying to mint, making it impossible for minting to an other than smart contract address. 2) Token can be minted from any address for any amount, this could lead to a token that can never be used and just resides in contract indefinitely, 3) No security checking if the minting address is a smart contract or not. If not, it can be used to maliciously mint to an incorrect or already existing smart contract causing loss to the targeted or already existing contracts
